label: rem:x5-bring-weight-geometric-content
title: Geometric content of the weight-$(-1)$ identification
html: This identification is categorical, not a morphism of curves. By Riemann–Hurwitz, there is no non-constant curve morphism \mathcal{X}_5 \to \mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{Br}} (g = 2 < 4). Furthermore, \mathcal{B}_{\mathrm{Br}} has no genus-2 Galois quotient because S_5 has no subgroups of index 2 or 3 with the requisite ramification. The proposition instead asserts a compatibility of \mathbb{Z}_5-graded observables under the Lagrange ordering. The same categorical weight-(-1) coordinate parametrises the single \mathrm{U}(1) phase tube of rem:u1-phase-tube and the first Fourier mode of Bring's geometry. See rem:x5-bring-prym-jacobian for the parallel structure at the level of Jacobians.
